summary: Frontend-only verification of jaleter.com deep-linking wiring. All 8 targeted flows PASS. openJaleter() correctly resolves each key to https://jaleter.com/<path> and invokes window.open('_blank','noopener') on Expo web preview. PoweredByJaleter footer renders on Login, Signup, More and Support hub screens. No hardcoded jaleter.com URLs found in touched call sites - all go through the openJaleter() helper. Settings terms/privacy rows correctly bypass LegalSheet and open jaleter.com/terms and jaleter.com/privacy directly. Signup Terms/Privacy text spans open the correct URLs WITHOUT toggling the signup-terms checkbox. No red-screen errors, no crashes, no console errors observed.

verified_flows.check: signup-terms-link opens https://jaleter.com/terms and does NOT toggle the terms checkbox (label text unchanged before/after tap)
more-visit-jaleter row present between Settings row and footer; opens https://jaleter.com/
coaching-open-jaleter step-2 card is now Pressable and opens https://jaleter.com/coaching
settings-terms row opens https://jaleter.com/terms and does NOT open LegalSheet (legal-close testID count = 0)
settings-privacy row opens https://jaleter.com/privacy and does NOT open LegalSheet
support-visit-website banner present between FAQs and footer; opens https://jaleter.com/support
PoweredByJaleter footer present at bottom of scroll view
support-help-bank_help still opens Bank Help Center (regression check)
support-new opens Contact Support form with support-subject / support-submit testIDs (regression check)

critical_code_review_comments: openJaleter() correctly falls back to Linking.openURL when WebBrowser is unavailable; error handling swallows exceptions - acceptable for UX.
PoweredByJaleter is a small, focused component using StyleSheet.create - clean.
All new call sites route through openJaleter(key) - no hardcoded URLs (verified via grep).
Icon change to 'open-outline' for Terms/Privacy rows in Settings is a nice UX signal that the tap leaves the app.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded user alex+test1@jaleter.app / password123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: openJaleter is intercepted for testing by overriding window.open BEFORE clicking: `await page.evaluate(() => { window.__opened=[]; window.open=(u,t)=>{window.__opened.push({u,t}); return null;}; });`. Then assert on `await page.evaluate(() => window.__opened)`. Welcome screen uses an iframe with postMessage - to skip Welcome and jump to Login/Signup: `await page.evaluate(() => window.postMessage('navigate:login', '*'))` or `'navigate:onboarding'` for the signup flow entry point. Bottom tabs do NOT include 'More' - it is reached via the `home-profile` avatar in the header.
